typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	OLEDBDestination_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		RUN_DATE as string,
		STATUS as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> FlatFileSource
FlatFileSource derive(AddLoadDate = currentTimestamp()) ~> DerivedColumn
DerivedColumn sink(input(
		Status as string,
		Load_Date as date 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		Run_Date as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,errorHandlingOption: 'allErrors',reportSuccessOnError: true,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		Status = STATUS,
		Load_Date = AddLoadDate,
		Run_Date = RUN_DATE),
	partitionFileNames:[($OLEDBDestination_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> OLEDBDestination
